# robust-predicates 3.0.2

`orient2d.js` is the unmodified unminified UMD implementation from the author's published npm release. It supplies adaptive exact-sign orientation predicates for polygon validity, segment intersection, triangulation and half-plane clipping.

- Official project: https://github.com/mourner/robust-predicates
- Exact release: https://registry.npmjs.org/robust-predicates/-/robust-predicates-3.0.2.tgz
- Release archive SHA-256: `962cacbec5dc58976307fa534c335331c11a1f8f315fc698776c4e1fc931e17e`
- UMD SHA-256: `61fcfb06cbcf08ddfc4fd3a71a091251074c93d75a7de62de3ec3b1d201ce77c`
- License: `LICENSE` (public domain / Unlicense).
- Retrieved: 2026-10-16.

`README.upstream.md` is the original release README. Adaptive exact-sign orientation does not make the complete area and distance calculations exact arithmetic; those use floating point and explicit validation tolerances.
